evals.prompt: I have a 10-page IEEEtran PDF and a source zip for TIFS. Check whether it is ready to upload: page/abstract limits, ORCID 0000-0001-6690-2603, source root, fonts, references, and tell me what to fix before I submit.
evals.expected_output: A preflight report with PASS/FAIL checks and the remaining portal steps.

evals.prompt: The portal asks whether the manuscript was previously published, whether it is a resubmission of a rejected paper, and whether identical preprints exist. Our paper has a public GitHub author copy and earlier Zenodo preprints; help me answer truthfully and list the files/statement I need.
evals.expected_output: Portal-answer matrix with evidence files and wording, not a yes/no guess.
